propositions: Define immutable logical operation and outcome types with canonical serialization via canonical_bytes to produce byte-identical UTF-8 JSON across equivalent values.
Establish a single provider-neutral retry budget owner in reconciler that permits exactly three physical invocations with a cumulative 15,000 ms sleep ceiling and deterministic fake-clock scheduling.

Implement diagnostic entry collection with allowlist-based field filtering, centralized message redaction via sanitize_diagnostic, and overflow handling that retains first seven entries plus a truncation sentinel.

After ambiguous writes, observe desired primary-store postcondition before attempting replay; observed desired state returns recovered, while failed or inconclusive observation returns non-replaying commit_unknown with ReplaySafety.forbidden.
Encode exact enum member sets for Disposition, FailureScope, ReplaySafety, and DelaySource as lowercase serialized strings with no additional values.
Preserve one immutable canonical logical_id UUID across all three invocations and observations of the same logical operation.
